reason: The bullet's market value of 134,351 is the output of B_01's silver-noncash cap (_apply_silver_noncash_cap in data/black_diamond/scripts/gold/B_01.holdings_lots.py), which scales market_value on open lots with no custody row to 22.9 percent of current_units times current_price while leaving cost_basis at 436,516, so accrued_gain reads -302,165. The price is not the defect: canonical 49.84 (yahoo_finance) and silver 49.31 (carry_forward) on 2026-10-09 agree, and all 60 open lots' per-share costs (32.68 to 40.98) lie within 20 percent of a canonical price seen within five days of acquisition, so cost is consistent too. At units times price the position is 587,547 against 436,516 cost, a gain of about 34.6 percent, so the served -69.2 percent is a market-value defect, not a real loss, and whether those units are held at custody is an open unit-count question (silver/unrealized holds no IQLT row for the advisor's 108 mapped accounts) that this trace does not settle.
